geopolitics_summary: Middle East Strait of Hormuz instability and Iran conflict risk permanent gas premium; EU carbon market under political pressure to loosen.

themes.headline: Natural gas prices surge amid Middle East violence and Strait disruption risk
themes.why_it_matters: Strait of Hormuz disruption forces permanent risk premium into LNG and swing gas; Asian demand heats up, tightening global LNG arb to TTF. Direct TTF upside via supply scarcity.

themes.headline: EU Commission loosens carbon market rules, extends industry pollution allowances to 2040s
themes.why_it_matters: Weaker EUA scarcity narrative if emission caps relaxed. Downward pressure on EUA forwards and reduced power-plant fuel-switch incentives (gas vs coal). Direct EUA and Day-Ahead spread risk.

themes.headline: EU methane rules risk supply shock; fossil fuel lobby warns, Commission skeptical
themes.why_it_matters: If methane compliance forces supplier exits, EU gas imports contract. Risk of supply-side shock to TTF. Outcome hinges on Commission enforcement stance and lobby pressure.

themes.headline: Turkey blocks NATO €27B fuel pipeline revamp; deal delay risk until September
themes.why_it_matters: NATO fuel infrastructure modernisation affects medium-term energy supply resilience in Europe. Delay to September adds geopolitical uncertainty to Q4 gas demand and heating curve.

themes.headline: Global LNG trade volumes hit record 56.3 Bcf/d in 2025 driven by US capacity expansion
themes.why_it_matters: US LNG capacity build increases global swing supply, moderating LNG arb to European TTF. Downward pressure on winter Cal+1 if US export growth continues outpacing demand.

watchlist: Middle East Strait of Hormuz traffic levels; track 2/3 baseline vs escalation risk to Q3 gas curve.
EU carbon market policy vote; Parliament/member state push-back on Commission's 2040s pollution allowance extension.
NATO fuel pipeline revamp negotiations; September deadline for Turkey compromise.
EU methane rule enforcement timeline and supplier response; supply shock probability by Q4 2026.
